description: Canonical and fail-closed tunnel authorization corpus for spec/06-security.md 8.11.

oracle.basis: RFC 9052 Sig_structure plus LICHEN security spec 8.11
oracle.implementation: independent PyNaCl reference_schnorr48.py; no lichen package imports

authorizations.name: valid
authorizations.description: Canonical root-to-egress authorization.

authorizations.name: seq_8
authorizations.description: Fresh sequence after the baseline grant.

authorizations.name: seq_9
authorizations.description: Sequence at a revocation floor.

authorizations.name: seq_10
authorizations.description: Sequence newer than a revocation floor.

authorizations.name: expired
authorizations.description: Authorization expiring exactly at evaluation time.

authorizations.name: wrong_kid
authorizations.description: Signed by root but carrying a different root kid.

authorizations.name: wrong_signer
authorizations.description: Header claims root but signature uses another key.

authorizations.name: wrong_egress
authorizations.description: Valid signature bound to another egress.

authorizations.name: other_root
authorizations.description: Valid authorization issued after root rotation.

authorizations.name: wrong_algorithm
authorizations.description: Valid signature over an unsupported algorithm.

authorizations.name: signature_bit
authorizations.description: One signature bit is changed.

authorizations.name: noncanonical_outer
authorizations.description: Non-shortest outer array encoding.

authorizations.name: trailing_data
authorizations.description: Canonical object followed by trailing CBOR.

authorizations.name: duplicate_protected
authorizations.description: Protected map repeats the alg label.

authorizations.name: duplicate_payload
authorizations.description: Payload map repeats target claim 1.

authorizations.name: missing_claim
authorizations.description: Payload omits egress claim 6.

authorizations.name: unknown_claim
authorizations.description: Payload contains unassigned claim 99.

authorizations.name: malformed_break
authorizations.description: A lone CBOR break byte.

authorizations.name: prefix_0
authorizations.description: Canonical zero-length prefix boundary.

authorizations.name: prefix_73
authorizations.description: Canonical non-octet prefix boundary.

authorizations.name: prefix_73_bad_tail
authorizations.description: Non-zero unused bits in a /73 target.

authorizations.name: prefix_128
authorizations.description: Canonical host prefix boundary.

authorizations.name: short_expiry
authorizations.description: Grant used to test exact data-plane expiry.
